name: Investor update
summary: Each month or quarter, the founder gets a drafted update for investors: the headline, key figures against plan and last period, cash and runway, wins, problems told plainly with what is being done, and specific asks. Every figure comes from the company's own reports. The founder approves and sends it.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own rules for prepared work, written for this template: the export read under named headers with a stop on any mismatch, the cash tie-out and runway rule, figures traced to named reports with the founder's own figures labelled apart, every gap written as a question, and a founder who writes the headline, causes and asks, approves and sends.

sources.contribution: The fixed sections of a regular investor update (headline, key metrics, wins, challenges, asks, team changes, cash and runway every time), honest reporting of problems and not skipping a hard month, asks specific enough to act on, a short update, and a separate investor note when serious news cannot wait.

Every figure set against plan, the same metrics every period with none dropped for looking bad, bad news given with what happened, its cause, its effect and the response, follow-up in later updates on problems raised earlier, the burn and runway story kept apart from the revenue story, and major news sent within days rather than at the regular date.
